status_key.provisional: Must be confirmed before detailed design
status_key.manufacturer_reference: Transcribed from manufacturer product brief; approximate reference dimensions, not physical measurements or production tolerances

keyboard.source: User: 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard M Edition manufacturer dimensions

mounting_holes.coordinate_convention: Portrait REAR view: u right from glass left, v down from glass top. Landscape front CAD: x = 248.096 - v, z = u; add screen origin. All mm.
mounting_holes.derivation: PCB right = 166.88 - 11.76 = 155.12; inner right u=155.12-47.16=107.96, left=right-49; outer right u=155.12-10.88=144.24, left=right-121.8. PCB top v=11.86; inner upper v=11.86+90.06=101.92, lower=upper+58; outer upper v=11.86+34.56=46.42, lower=upper+160.
mounting_holes.note: Markers represent screw axes only. Do not infer bore diameter, thread engagement, boss width or mount-plane depth from marker geometry.

display.viewing_angle_note: User specification; full/half angle convention unspecified
display.pi_rear_mount_source: User-confirmed mounting capability; brief confirms Pi 5 compatibility and shows 58 × 49 mm inner M2.5 pattern; board placement/orientation requires Pi drawing

drive.source: Invented planning envelope for housed slim USB floppy; no selected product
drive.alternatives: Slim USB with removable retro cosmetic bezel OR legacy drive plus USB adapter; latter requires new envelopes, power and adapter checks

pi.source: Nominal Pi 5 board envelope; official drawing retrieval blocked, not drawing-verified
pi.mount_note: Provisional board centered around inner screw pattern; board-edge offsets and port orientation are not yet drawing-verified. Display axes are mapped but board holes are not generated.

design.mount_axis_marker_note: Visualization only: radius equals half nominal M2.5 thread size, not a drilled hole.

manufacturing.material: PLA prototypes; PETG candidate for final load-bearing shell after thermal/load tests
manufacturing.build_volume_source: Nominal published volumes; usable margins/brims to be confirmed in slicer

power.note: User: external power for v1; battery and other additions may follow. No space promised for them.

prototype.revision: P1 reference-hardware prototype; fit and load testing outstanding

drive.reference_model: TEAC FD-235HF, standard PC 34-pin 1.44 MB class
drive.status: provisional nominal reference; manufacturer website blocked; exact suffix/mechanism must be checked

cooler.reference: Raspberry Pi Active Cooler form-factor allowance
cooler.status: provisional clearance envelope, not an accurate product model

hub.reference: Adjustable cradle for a powered USB hub; choose a hub within the reserved envelope

carrier.retention: Two padded webbing straps across keyboard underside; keycaps face protective cover. Peripheral housing contacts need physical fit checks.

handle.type: 25 mm webbing handle, bolted clamp bars and full-width aluminium backing bar
handle.status: Prototype load path only; metal bar and physical proof-load test required before carrying hardware
handle.end_stop_note: Sewn webbing return around steel crosspin outside each clamp; pin/loop cannot pass the 2.5 mm clamp channel. Physical proof-load required.

fasteners.method: Through screws and captive hex nuts; no glue-only service joints and no unverified heat-set insert selection
fasteners.basis: Nominal ISO metric hardware geometry; selected vendor tolerances and printed fits require coupon testing

printer.note: H2C manufacturer page inaccessible. Parts are designed and numerically checked against an A1-sized 256 mm cube with 6 mm total nominal margin. Confirm slicer/brim requirements.

io.hub_cutout: Generic rectangle, adjust to actual powered hub

controls.usb_controller: One tested USB floppy controller per drive; no model or compatibility claim yet

research.result: Manufacturer pages denied by configured proxy (HTTP 403); selections and detailed keyboard geometry are explicit design assumptions. Uploaded display brief remains the verified source available in-session.
